definition: Study-generated pseudonymous stable firm ID.
exclusion_or_guard: Never derive or expose confidential external identifiers in analysis outputs.

definition: Privacy-preserving token derived inside an approved linkage boundary for corporations.
exclusion_or_guard: Raw corporation number is not stored in the analysis dataset.

definition: Corporation / sole proprietor / other private legal form.
exclusion_or_guard: Needed to detect frame gaps, especially sole proprietors.

definition: Pre-specified industry classification.
exclusion_or_guard: Do not post-hoc collapse solely to improve treatment significance.

definition: Sampling/calibration geography.
exclusion_or_guard: Use only granularity allowed by disclosure control.

definition: Employees on a consistent headcount basis.
exclusion_or_guard: Record definition changes across waves.

definition: Known unit selection probability under probability-frame path.
exclusion_or_guard: If unknown, national c_VAT eligibility is false.

definition: Inverse sampling probability.
exclusion_or_guard: Not defined for convenience/recruited pilot.

definition: Pre-specified response/attrition adjustment from frame covariates.
exclusion_or_guard: MAR-based adjustment requires explicit sensitivity for remaining selection.

definition: Final weight calibrated to approved frame/public margins on pre-specified cells.
exclusion_or_guard: Calibration cannot repair units absent from the sampling frame without an explicit coverage model.

definition: Taxable/exempt status and applicable regime.
exclusion_or_guard: Do not infer solely from invoice registration.

definition: General/simplified/other relevant VAT filing regime.
exclusion_or_guard: Rule-vintage changes must be dated.

definition: Qualified-invoice issuer status/history.
exclusion_or_guard: Registration is endogenous; not a randomized treatment.

definition: Minutes spent on a single VAT-classified task event.
exclusion_or_guard: No annualization from a short diary for the primary annual estimand.

definition: Invoice issue/receipt-validation, VAT classification, record retention, return prep, adviser coordination, other pre-specified tasks.
exclusion_or_guard: Free-text new categories remain exploratory until separately classified.

definition: DISAPPEARS_WITH_VAT / RETAINED_GENERAL_ACCOUNTING / MIXED_UNCERTAIN.
exclusion_or_guard: Primary c_VAT includes only VAT-specific class; mixed tasks enter sensitivity only.

definition: Role of employee performing VAT task.
exclusion_or_guard: Avoid one national wage for heterogeneous roles.

definition: Pre-specified opportunity-cost valuation for internal VAT time.
exclusion_or_guard: Wage bridge assumptions reported separately; no productivity multiplier.

definition: Incremental recurring adviser/accountant/software/e-invoice expenditure attributed to VAT administration.
exclusion_or_guard: Tax remittance and general accounting spend excluded; price is not automatically social resource cost.

definition: VAT-specific provider labor/resource input attributable to participant service.
exclusion_or_guard: If unavailable, model-compatible external real-resource component remains unidentified.

definition: One-time setup/training/migration resource use caused by intervention or policy transition.
exclusion_or_guard: Excluded from recurring c_VAT numerator.

definition: Assignment to standardized VAT-specific burden-reduction offer.
exclusion_or_guard: Primary causal analysis is ITT; assignment must be immutable/auditable.

definition: Actual activation/adoption date.
exclusion_or_guard: Adoption is endogenous; use assignment as instrument only under pre-specified assumptions.

definition: Provider-side resources consumed by the study intervention.
exclusion_or_guard: Must be included when claiming net social resource release.

definition: Released worker time reassigned to production, sales, R&D or other pre-specified productive activity.
exclusion_or_guard: Do not infer from higher sales; measure reassignment directly.

definition: Released time reassigned to retained administration, leisure/idle time, or other non-primary categories.
exclusion_or_guard: Used to reconcile released minutes; categories pre-specified.

definition: Firm sales.
exclusion_or_guard: Not used as denominator for national resource share because intermediate transactions double count.

definition: Intermediate purchases on aligned accounting basis.
exclusion_or_guard: Definition fixed across waves.

definition: Value added on a pre-specified accounting basis, directly reported or derived from components.
exclusion_or_guard: Primary denominator; derivation documented and harmonized.

definition: Capital investment.
exclusion_or_guard: No causal claim absent valid treatment and pre-specified window.

definition: Firm fiscal-year end.
exclusion_or_guard: Align annual resource/outcome windows.

definition: VAT return/interim filing frequency relevant to task-cycle timing.
exclusion_or_guard: Short windows that miss annual/periodic tasks cannot identify annual c_VAT.

definition: Completion/missingness status for each required module.
exclusion_or_guard: Attrition handled using pre-specified weights/sensitivity; not silently listwise-deleted.
